46func replaceManagedFragment(path string, fragment []byte, previousDigest string) (string, []byte, bool, error) {
47 fragmentPath := managedFragment(path)
48 oldBytes, oldExists, err := readOwnedFile(fragmentPath, previousDigest)
49 if err != nil {
50 return "", nil, false, err
51 }
52 if err := ensureFragmentAvailable(fragmentPath, oldExists); err != nil {
53 return "", nil, false, err
54 }
55 if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(fragmentPath), 0700); err != nil {
56 return "", nil, false, err
57 }
58 if err := writePrivateFile(fragmentPath, fragment); err != nil {
59 return "", nil, false, err
60 }
61 return fragmentPath, oldBytes, oldExists, nil
62}
63
64func ensureFragmentAvailable(path string, alreadyManaged bool) error {
65 if alreadyManaged {
66 return nil
67 }
68 if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
69 return fmt.Errorf("plugin fragment already exists and is not managed by dch")
70 } else if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
71 return err
72 }
73 return nil
74}

76type enableRollback struct {
77 manager *Manager
78 path string
79 old common.ProjectPlugins
80 hadOld bool
81 wasEnabled bool
82 wasActive bool
83 fragmentPath string
84 oldBytes []byte
85 oldFileExists bool
86 runtimeDir string
87 unit serviceUnitChange
88 serviceTouched bool
89}
90
91func (rollback *enableRollback) run(cause error, serviceTouched bool) error {
92 rollback.serviceTouched = serviceTouched
93 cleanup := rollback.stopService()
94 if len(cleanup) == 0 {
95 cleanup = appendError(cleanup, rollback.unit.restore())
96 }
97 cleanup = appendError(cleanup, removeCredentialSocket(rollback.runtimeDir))
98 if len(cleanup) > 0 {
99 return fmt.Errorf("%w; cleanup failed, settings remain enabled for retry: %w", cause, errors.Join(cleanup...))
100 }
101 cleanup = rollback.restoreSettings()
102 if rollback.wasActive && rollback.wasEnabled {
103 cleanup = appendError(cleanup, rollback.manager.startAndCheck(context.Background(), rollback.path))
104 }
105 if len(cleanup) > 0 {
106 return fmt.Errorf("%w; rollback incomplete: %w", cause, errors.Join(cleanup...))
107 }
108 return cause
109}
110
111type ensureRollback struct {
112 unit serviceUnitChange
113 metadataChanged bool
114 project common.ProjectPlugins
115 config common.Config
116 path string
117 oldState common.PluginState
118}
119
120func (rollback ensureRollback) run(cause error) error {
121 if !rollback.metadataChanged {
122 return cause
123 }
124 var restoreErr error
125 restoreErr = errors.Join(restoreErr, rollback.unit.restore())
126 rollback.project.States[githubAppID] = rollback.oldState
127 rollback.config.ProjectPlugins[rollback.path] = rollback.project
128 restoreErr = errors.Join(restoreErr, common.SaveConfig(rollback.config))
129 restoreErr = errors.Join(restoreErr, runSystemctl(context.Background(), "daemon-reload"))
130 if restoreErr != nil {
131 return fmt.Errorf("%w; previous unit restore failed: %w", cause, restoreErr)
132 }
133 return cause
134}
135
136func verifyOwnedUnit(path, expectedDigest string) error {
137 info, err := os.Lstat(path)
138 if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
139 return nil
140 }
141 if err != nil {
142 return err
143 }
144 if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || !ownedByCurrentUser(info) {
145 return fmt.Errorf("systemd unit is unsafe")
146 }
147 data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
148 if err != nil {
149 return err
150 }
151 if expectedDigest == "" || digest(data) != expectedDigest {
152 return fmt.Errorf("systemd unit was modified; refusing to remove it")
153 }
154 return nil
155}
156
157func (rollback *enableRollback) stopService() []error {
158 if !rollback.serviceTouched {
159 return nil
160 }
161 var cleanup []error
162 for _, action := range [][]string{{"stop", unitName(rollback.path)}, {"disable", unitName(rollback.path)}, {"daemon-reload"}} {
163 cleanup = appendError(cleanup, runSystemctl(context.Background(), action...))
164 }
165 return cleanup
166}
167
168func (rollback *enableRollback) restoreSettings() []error {
169 var cleanup []error
170 cleanup = appendError(cleanup, restoreFile(rollback.fragmentPath, rollback.oldBytes, rollback.oldFileExists))
171 current, err := common.LoadConfig()
172 if err != nil {
173 return appendError(cleanup, err)
174 }
175 if rollback.hadOld {
176 current.ProjectPlugins[rollback.path] = rollback.old
177 } else {
178 delete(current.ProjectPlugins, rollback.path)
179 }
180 return appendError(cleanup, common.SaveConfig(current))
181}
182
183func removeCredentialSocket(runtimeDir string) error {
184 err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(runtimeDir, "credential.sock"))
185 if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
186 return nil
187 }
188 return err
189}
190
191func appendError(errs []error, err error) []error {
192 if err != nil {
193 return append(errs, err)
194 }
195 return errs
196}

390func (m *Manager) checkReady(ctx context.Context, runtimeDir string) error {

400 break

402 select {
403 case <-ctx.Done():
404 return ctx.Err()
405 case <-deadline.C:
406 return fmt.Errorf("credential service socket did not become ready")
407 case <-tick.C:
408 }
409 }

456func (m *Manager) prepareServiceUnit(projectPath string, previous common.PluginState) (serviceUnitChange, error) {
457 var change serviceUnitChange
458 unit, err := unitPath(projectPath)
459 if previous.UnitPath != "" {
460 unit = previous.UnitPath
461 if err := validateUnitPath(unit, projectPath); err != nil {
462 return change, err
463 }
464 } else if err != nil {
465 return change, err
466 }
467 content, err := m.serviceUnitContent(projectPath)

475func prepareUnitFile(change serviceUnitChange, previousDigest string, content []byte) (serviceUnitChange, error) {
476 info, err := os.Lstat(change.path)
477 if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
478 return createUnitFile(change, content)
479 }
480 if err != nil {
481 return change, err
482 }
483 return replaceUnitFile(change, previousDigest, content, info)
484}
485
486func createUnitFile(change serviceUnitChange, content []byte) (serviceUnitChange, error) {
487 if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(change.path), 0700); err != nil {
488 return change, err
489 }
490 if err := writePrivateFile(change.path, content); err != nil {
491 return change, err
492 }
493 change.changed = true
494 return change, nil
495}
496
497func replaceUnitFile(change serviceUnitChange, previousDigest string, content []byte, info os.FileInfo) (serviceUnitChange, error) {
498 if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || !ownedByCurrentUser(info) {
499 return change, fmt.Errorf("systemd unit is unsafe")
500 }
501 existing, err := os.ReadFile(change.path)
502 if err != nil {
503 return change, err
504 }
505 if previousDigest == "" || digest(existing) != previousDigest {
506 return change, fmt.Errorf("systemd unit was modified; refusing to replace it")
507 }
508 change.before = existing
509 change.existed = true
510 change.changed = !bytes.Equal(existing, content)
511 if change.changed {
512 if err := writePrivateFile(change.path, content); err != nil {
513 return change, err
514 }
515 }
516 return change, nil
517}

526func (m *Manager) serviceUnitContent(projectPath string) ([]byte, error) {
527 configPath, err := common.ConfigPath()
528 if err != nil {
529 return nil, err
530 }
531 bin, err := os.Executable()
532 if err != nil {
533 return nil, err
534 }
535 content := "[Unit]\nDescription=dch GitHub App credential service\n\n[Service]\nType=simple\nExecStart=" + systemdExecArg(bin) + " _github-app-serve --project " + systemdExecArg(projectPath) + "\nRestart=on-failure\n"
536 for _, key := range []string{"DCH_CONFIG", "XDG_RUNTIME_DIR", "PATH", "GNUPGHOME", "PASSWORD_STORE_DIR"} {
537 value := os.Getenv(key)
538 if key == "DCH_CONFIG" {
539 value = configPath
540 }
541 if value != "" {
542 content += "Environment=" + systemdEnv(key, value) + "\n"
543 }
544 }
545 content += "\n[Install]\nWantedBy=default.target\n"
546 return []byte(content), nil
547}

549func ownedByCurrentUser(info os.FileInfo) bool {
550 stat, ok := info.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
551 return ok && int(stat.Uid) == os.Getuid()
552}

554func runSystemctl(ctx context.Context, args ...string) error {
555 args = append([]string{"--user"}, args...)
556 commandCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 10*time.Second)
557 defer cancel()
558 cmd := exec.CommandContext(commandCtx, "systemctl", args...)
559 var output limitedOutput
560 cmd.Stdout = &output
561 cmd.Stderr = &output
562 if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
563 return fmt.Errorf("systemctl %s failed: %s", args[1], strings.TrimSpace(output.String()))
564 }
565 return nil
566}

568type limitedOutput struct{ buffer bytes.Buffer }
569
570func (output *limitedOutput) Write(data []byte) (int, error) {
571 const limit = 4096
572 originalLength := len(data)
573 remaining := limit - output.buffer.Len()
574 if remaining > 0 {
575 if len(data) > remaining {
576 data = data[:remaining]
577 }
578 _, _ = output.buffer.Write(data)
579 }
580 return originalLength, nil
581}
582func (output *limitedOutput) String() string { return output.buffer.String() }

584func systemdArg(s string) string {
585 return "\"" + strings.NewReplacer("\\", "\\\\", "\"", "\\\"", "\n", "\\n", "\r", "\\r", "%", "%%").Replace(s) + "\""
586}
587func systemdExecArg(s string) string { return systemdArg(strings.ReplaceAll(s, "$", "$$")) }
588func systemdEnv(key, value string) string { return systemdArg(key + "=" + value) }

630func readOwnedFile(path, expected string) ([]byte, bool, error) {
631 info, err := os.Lstat(path)
632 if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
633 return nil, false, nil
634 }
635 if err != nil {
636 return nil, false, err
637 }
638 if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
639 return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("plugin fragment is not a regular file")
640 }
641 data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
642 if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
643 return nil, false, nil
644 }
645 if err != nil {
646 return nil, false, err
647 }
648 if expected == "" || digest(data) != expected {
649 return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("plugin fragment was modified; refusing to overwrite or remove it")
650 }
651 return data, true, nil
652}
653
654func writePrivateFile(path string, data []byte) error {
655 tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".dch-plugin-*")
656 if err != nil {
657 return err
658 }
659 defer os.Remove(tmp.Name())
660 if err := tmp.Chmod(0600); err != nil {
661 tmp.Close()
662 return err
663 }
664 if _, err := tmp.Write(data); err != nil {
665 tmp.Close()
666 return err
667 }
668 if err := tmp.Sync(); err != nil {
669 tmp.Close()
670 return err
671 }
672 if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
673 return err
674 }
675 return os.Rename(tmp.Name(), path)
676}
677
678func restoreFile(path string, data []byte, existed bool) error {
679 if existed {
680 return writePrivateFile(path, data)
681 }
682 if err := os.Remove(path); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
683 return err
684 }
685 return nil
686}

688func lockConfig() (func(), error) {
689 path, err := common.ConfigPath()
690 if err != nil {
691 return nil, err
692 }
693 if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0700); err != nil {
694 return nil, err
695 }
696 fd, err := syscall.Open(path+".plugins.lock", syscall.O_CREAT|syscall.O_RDWR|syscall.O_CLOEXEC|syscall.O_NOFOLLOW, 0600)
697 if err != nil {
698 return nil, err
699 }
700 file := os.NewFile(uintptr(fd), path+".plugins.lock")
701 info, err := file.Stat()
702 if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || !ownedByCurrentUser(info) {
703 _ = file.Close()
704 return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugin config lock is unsafe")
705 }
706 if err := file.Chmod(0600); err != nil {
707 _ = file.Close()
708 return nil, err
709 }
710 if err := syscall.Flock(fd, syscall.LOCK_EX); err != nil {
711 _ = file.Close()
712 return nil, err
713 }
714 return func() { _ = syscall.Flock(fd, syscall.LOCK_UN); _ = file.Close() }, nil
715}

51func NewProvider(cfg Config, options ...ProviderOptions) (*Provider, error) {
52 if err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {
53 return nil, err
54 }
55 if len(options) > 1 {
56 return nil, fmt.Errorf("only one provider options value is supported")
57 }
58 opts := ProviderOptions{}
59 if len(options) == 1 {
60 opts = options[0]
61 }
62 if opts.PassPath == "" {
63 opts.PassPath = "pass"
64 }
65 if opts.PassTimeout <= 0 {
66 opts.PassTimeout = 10 * time.Second
67 }
68 if opts.RequestTimeout <= 0 {
69 opts.RequestTimeout = 15 * time.Second
70 }
71 if opts.APIBaseURL == "" {
72 opts.APIBaseURL = "https://api.github.com"
73 }
74 if opts.Now == nil {
75 opts.Now = time.Now
76 }
77 if opts.HTTPClient == nil {
78 opts.HTTPClient = &http.Client{Timeout: opts.RequestTimeout, CheckRedirect: func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }}
79 } else {
80 client := *opts.HTTPClient
81 client.Timeout = opts.RequestTimeout
82 client.CheckRedirect = func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }
83 opts.HTTPClient = &client
84 }
85 u, err := url.Parse(opts.APIBaseURL)
86 if err != nil || u.Scheme != "https" && opts.APIBaseURL != "http://127.0.0.1" && !strings.HasPrefix(opts.APIBaseURL, "http://127.0.0.1:") {
87 return nil, fmt.Errorf("GitHub API URL must use HTTPS")
88 }
89 return &Provider{cfg: cfg, opts: opts}, nil
90}

92func (p *Provider) Token(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
93 for {
94 p.mu.Lock()
95 if p.token != "" && p.opts.Now().Add(5*time.Minute).Before(p.expires) {
96 token := p.token
97 p.mu.Unlock()
98 return token, nil
99 }
100 if call := p.refreshing; call != nil {
101 p.mu.Unlock()
102 return awaitRefresh(ctx, call)
103 }
104 call := &refreshCall{done: make(chan struct{})}
105 p.refreshing = call
106 p.mu.Unlock()
107 return p.refreshToken(ctx, call)
108 }
109}

111func awaitRefresh(ctx context.Context, call *refreshCall) (string, error) {
112 select {
113 case <-call.done:
114 if call.err != nil {
115 return "", call.err
116 }
117 return call.token, nil
118 case <-ctx.Done():
119 return "", ctx.Err()
120 }
121}
122
123func (p *Provider) refreshToken(ctx context.Context, call *refreshCall) (string, error) {
124 token, expiry, err := p.mint(ctx)
125 p.mu.Lock()
126 if err == nil {
127 p.token, p.expires = token, expiry
128 call.token = token
129 } else {
130 call.err = err
131 }
132 p.refreshing = nil
133 close(call.done)
134 p.mu.Unlock()
135 return token, err
136}

141 return "", time.Time{}, err
142 }
143 jwt, err := p.createAppJWT(key)

148 if err := p.verifyRepositoryInstallation(ctx, jwt, owner, repo); err != nil {
149 return "", time.Time{}, err

154func (p *Provider) loadPrivateKey(ctx context.Context) (*rsa.PrivateKey, error) {
155 passCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, p.opts.PassTimeout)
156 defer cancel()
157 cmd := exec.CommandContext(passCtx, p.opts.PassPath, "show", p.cfg.PrivateKeyPassEntry)
158 cmd.Stdin = nil
159 cmd.Stdout = nil
160 cmd.Stderr = io.Discard
161 cmd.Env = securePassEnvironment(os.Environ())
162 var keyOutput boundedBuffer
163 cmd.Stdout = &keyOutput
164 if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil || keyOutput.overflow {
165 return nil, fmt.Errorf("pass failed")
166 }
167 return parsePrivateKey(keyOutput.Bytes())
168}

170func (p *Provider) createAppJWT(key *rsa.PrivateKey) (string, error) {
171 now := p.opts.Now()
172 issued := now.Add(-60 * time.Second)
173 claims, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"iat": issued.Unix(), "exp": now.Add(9 * time.Minute).Unix(), "iss": p.cfg.appIDString()})
174 header := base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(`{"alg":"RS256","typ":"JWT"}`))
175 unsigned := header + "." + base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(claims)
176 digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(unsigned))
177 signature, err := rsa.SignPKCS1v15(rand.Reader, key, crypto.SHA256, digest[:])
178 if err != nil {
179 return "", err
180 }
181 return unsigned + "." + base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(signature), nil
182}

184func (p *Provider) verifyRepositoryInstallation(ctx context.Context, jwt, owner, repo string) error {
185 verifyURL := strings.TrimRight(p.opts.APIBaseURL, "/") + "/repos/" + url.PathEscape(owner) + "/" + url.PathEscape(repo) + "/installation"
186 verifyReq, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, verifyURL, nil)
187 verifyReq.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+jwt)
188 verifyReq.Header.Set("Accept", "application/vnd.github+json")
189 verifyReq.Header.Set("X-GitHub-Api-Version", "2022-11-28")
190 verifyResp, err := p.opts.HTTPClient.Do(verifyReq)
191 if err != nil {
192 return fmt.Errorf("repository installation verification failed")
193 }
194 defer verifyResp.Body.Close()
195 verifyData, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(verifyResp.Body, maxResponseBytes+1))
196 var installation struct {
197 ID int64 `json:"id"`
198 }
199 if err != nil || len(verifyData) > maxResponseBytes || verifyResp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK || json.Unmarshal(verifyData, &installation) != nil || installation.ID != p.cfg.InstallationID {
200 return fmt.Errorf("repository installation verification failed")
201 }
202 return nil
203}

205func (p *Provider) requestInstallationToken(ctx context.Context, jwt, repo string) (string, time.Time, error) {
206 var body bytes.Buffer
207 permissions := make(map[string]string, len(p.cfg.Permissions))
208 for k, v := range p.cfg.Permissions {
209 permissions[k] = v
210 }
211 if err := json.NewEncoder(&body).Encode(map[string]any{"repositories": []string{repo}, "permissions": permissions}); err != nil {
212 return "", time.Time{}, err
213 }
214 u := strings.TrimRight(p.opts.APIBaseURL, "/") + fmt.Sprintf("/app/installations/%d/access_tokens", p.cfg.InstallationID)
215 req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, u, &body)
216 req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+jwt)
217 req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/vnd.github+json")
218 req.Header.Set("X-GitHub-Api-Version", "2022-11-28")
219 req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
220 resp, err := p.opts.HTTPClient.Do(req)
221 if err != nil {
222 return "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("GitHub token request failed")
223 }
224 defer resp.Body.Close()
225 data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, maxResponseBytes+1))
226 if err != nil || len(data) > maxResponseBytes || resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
227 return "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("GitHub token request failed")
228 }
229 var minted struct {
230 Token string `json:"token"`
231 ExpiresAt string `json:"expires_at"`
232 }
233 if json.Unmarshal(data, &minted) != nil || minted.Token == "" || strings.ContainsAny(minted.Token, "\r\n") {
234 return "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid GitHub token response")
235 }
236 expires, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, minted.ExpiresAt)
237 if err != nil || !expires.After(p.opts.Now().Add(5*time.Minute)) {
238 return "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid GitHub token expiry")
239 }
240 return minted.Token, expires, nil
241}
242
243func parsePrivateKey(data []byte) (*rsa.PrivateKey, error) {
244 block, _ := pem.Decode(data)
245 if block == nil {
246 return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid RSA private key")
247 }
248 if key, err := x509.ParsePKCS1PrivateKey(block.Bytes); err == nil {
249 return key, nil
250 }
251 parsed, err := x509.ParsePKCS8PrivateKey(block.Bytes)
252 if err != nil {
253 return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid RSA private key")
254 }
255 key, ok := parsed.(*rsa.PrivateKey)
256 if !ok {
257 return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid RSA private key")
258 }
259 return key, nil
260}
261
262type boundedBuffer struct {
263 bytes.Buffer
264 overflow bool
265}
266
267func securePassEnvironment(env []string) []string {
268 filtered := make([]string, 0, len(env)+2)
269 var gpgOptions string
270 for _, item := range env {
271 if strings.HasPrefix(item, "GPG_TTY=") {
272 continue
273 }
274 if strings.HasPrefix(item, "PASSWORD_STORE_GPG_OPTS=") {
275 gpgOptions = strings.TrimPrefix(item, "PASSWORD_STORE_GPG_OPTS=")
276 continue
277 }
278 filtered = append(filtered, item)
279 }
280 return append(filtered, "GPG_TTY=", "PASSWORD_STORE_GPG_OPTS="+strings.TrimSpace(gpgOptions+" --batch --pinentry-mode error"))
281}
282
283func (b *boundedBuffer) Write(p []byte) (int, error) {
284 if b.Len()+len(p) > maxResponseBytes {
285 b.overflow = true
286 return 0, fmt.Errorf("output too large")
287 }
288 return b.Buffer.Write(p)
289}

1package githubapp

16func Serve(ctx context.Context, socketPath string, cfg Config) error {
17 listener, provider, releaseLock, err := prepareCredentialSocket(socketPath, cfg)
18 if err != nil {
19 return err
20 }
21 defer releaseLock()
22 server := &http.Server{Handler: credentialMux(provider), ReadHeaderTimeout: 5 * time.Second}
23 return serveUntilCancelled(ctx, server, listener, socketPath)
24}

26func prepareCredentialSocket(socketPath string, cfg Config) (net.Listener, *Provider, func(), error) {
27 if err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {
28 return nil, nil, nil, err
29 }
30 if len(socketPath) > 100 {
31 return nil, nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("socket path is too long")
32 }
33 parentInfo, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Dir(socketPath))
34 if err != nil || !parentInfo.IsDir() || parentInfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !ownedByCurrentUser(parentInfo) || parentInfo.Mode().Perm() != 0700 {
35 return nil, nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("socket directory is unsafe")
36 }
37 releaseLock, err := acquireServerLock(socketPath + ".lock")
38 if err != nil {
39 return nil, nil, nil, err
40 }
41 listener, provider, err := listenCredentialSocket(socketPath, cfg)
42 if err != nil {
43 releaseLock()
44 return nil, nil, nil, err
45 }
46 return listener, provider, releaseLock, nil
47}
48
49func listenCredentialSocket(socketPath string, cfg Config) (net.Listener, *Provider, error) {
50 if info, err := os.Lstat(socketPath); err == nil {
51 if info.Mode()&os.ModeSocket == 0 {
52 return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("socket path is unsafe")
53 }
54 if err := os.Remove(socketPath); err != nil {
55 return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot remove stale socket")
56 }
57 } else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
58 return nil, nil, err
59 }
60 listener, err := net.Listen("unix", socketPath)
61 if err != nil {
62 return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot listen on credential socket")
63 }
64 if err := os.Chmod(socketPath, 0600); err != nil {
65 listener.Close()
66 os.Remove(socketPath)
67 return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot secure credential socket")
68 }
69 provider, err := NewProvider(cfg)
70 if err != nil {
71 listener.Close()
72 os.Remove(socketPath)
73 return nil, nil, err
74 }
75 return listener, provider, nil
76}
77
78func credentialMux(provider *Provider) *http.ServeMux {
79 mux := http.NewServeMux()
80 mux.HandleFunc("/health", healthHandler)
81 mux.HandleFunc("/credential", credentialHandler(provider))
82 return mux
83}
84
85func healthHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
86 if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
87 http.Error(w, "method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
88 return
89 }
90 w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
91 _, _ = io.WriteString(w, "ok\n")
92}
93
94func credentialHandler(provider *Provider) http.HandlerFunc {
95 return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
96 w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
97 if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
98 http.Error(w, "method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
99 return
100 }
101 token, err := provider.Token(r.Context())
102 if err != nil {
103 http.Error(w, "credential unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
104 return
105 }
106 w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
107 _, _ = io.WriteString(w, token)
108 }
109}
110
111func serveUntilCancelled(ctx context.Context, server *http.Server, listener net.Listener, socketPath string) error {
112 done := make(chan struct{})
113 go func() {
114 select {
115 case <-ctx.Done():
116 _ = server.Close()
117 case <-done:
118 }
119 }()
120 err := server.Serve(listener)
121 close(done)
122 _ = os.Remove(socketPath)
123 if err == http.ErrServerClosed {
124 return nil
125 }
126 return fmt.Errorf("credential server failed")
127}
128
129func acquireServerLock(path string) (func(), error) {
130 fd, err := syscall.Open(path, syscall.O_CREAT|syscall.O_RDWR|syscall.O_CLOEXEC|syscall.O_NOFOLLOW, 0600)
131 if err != nil {
132 return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot open credential server lock")
133 }
134 file := os.NewFile(uintptr(fd), path)
135 info, err := file.Stat()
136 if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || !ownedByCurrentUser(info) {
137 file.Close()
138 return nil, fmt.Errorf("credential server lock is unsafe")
139 }
140 if err := file.Chmod(0600); err != nil {
141 file.Close()
142 return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot secure credential server lock")
143 }
144 if err := syscall.Flock(fd, syscall.LOCK_EX|syscall.LOCK_NB); err != nil {
145 file.Close()
146 return nil, fmt.Errorf("credential server is already running")
147 }
148 return func() { _ = syscall.Flock(fd, syscall.LOCK_UN); _ = file.Close() }, nil
149}
150
151func CheckCredential(ctx context.Context, socketPath string) error {
152 client := unixHTTPClient(socketPath)
153 req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, "http://unix/credential", nil)
154 if err != nil {
155 return fmt.Errorf("cannot check credential service")
156 }
157 resp, err := client.Do(req)
158 if err != nil {
159 return fmt.Errorf("credential service unavailable")
160 }
161 defer resp.Body.Close()
162 if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
163 return fmt.Errorf("credential service rejected check")
164 }
165 data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, maxResponseBytes+1))
166 if err != nil || len(data) == 0 || len(data) > maxResponseBytes || strings.ContainsAny(string(data), "\r\n") {
167 return fmt.Errorf("credential service returned invalid token")
168 }
169 return nil
170}
171
172func unixHTTPClient(path string) *http.Client {
173 return &http.Client{Timeout: 20 * time.Second, Transport: &http.Transport{DialContext: func(ctx context.Context, _, _ string) (net.Conn, error) {
174 return (&net.Dialer{}).DialContext(ctx, "unix", path)
175 }}, CheckRedirect: func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }}
176}

36// WriteAdapterScripts securely writes the non-secret container adapter scripts under socketDir/bin.

40 }

72func validateOwnedDir(path string, mode fs.FileMode) error {
73 info, err := os.Lstat(path)

84func writePrivateFile(path string, content []byte, mode fs.FileMode) error {
85 if info, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
86 if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || !ownedByCurrentUser(info) || info.Mode().Perm() != mode.Perm() {
87 return fmt.Errorf("unsafe existing adapter script")
88 }
89 } else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
90 return err
91 }
92 tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".dch-adapter-*")
93 if err != nil {
94 return err
95 }
96 tmpPath := tmp.Name()
97 defer os.Remove(tmpPath)
98 if err := tmp.Chmod(mode); err != nil {
99 _ = tmp.Close()
100 return err
101 }
102 if _, err := tmp.Write(content); err != nil {
103 _ = tmp.Close()
104 return err
105 }
106 if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {

119const gitCredentialScript = `#!/bin/sh
120set -eu
121operation=${1-}
122[ "$operation" = get ] || exit 0
123protocol=
124host=
125while IFS= read -r line; do
126 case "$line" in
127 protocol=*) protocol=${line#protocol=} ;;
128 host=*) host=${line#host=} ;;
129 esac
130done
131[ "$protocol" = https ] && [ "$host" = github.com ] || exit 0
132token=$(curl --disable --noproxy '*' --unix-socket /run/dch-github/credential.sock --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 20 http://localhost/credential) || exit 1
133[ -n "$token" ] || exit 1
134printf 'username=x-access-token\npassword=%s\n\n' "$token"
135`
136
137const ghWrapperScript = `#!/bin/sh
138set -eu
139adapter_bin=/run/dch-github/bin
140rest=${PATH-}
141clean_path=
142while :; do
143 case "$rest" in
144 *:*) part=${rest%%:*}; rest=${rest#*:}; more=yes ;;
145 *) part=$rest; rest=; more=no ;;
146 esac
147 if [ "$part" != "$adapter_bin" ]; then
148 if [ -n "$clean_path" ]; then clean_path=$clean_path:$part; else clean_path=$part; fi
149 fi
150 [ "$more" = yes ] || break
151done
152PATH=$clean_path
153export PATH
154real_gh=$(command -v gh) || { echo 'dch: gh is required' >&2; exit 127; }
155token=$(curl --disable --noproxy '*' --unix-socket /run/dch-github/credential.sock --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 20 http://localhost/credential) || { echo 'dch: GitHub credential unavailable' >&2; exit 1; }
156[ -n "$token" ] || { echo 'dch: GitHub credential unavailable' >&2; exit 1; }
157GH_TOKEN=$token
158export GH_TOKEN
159exec "$real_gh" "$@"
160`

191func (capture *diagnosticCapture) Write(data []byte) (int, error) {
192 capture.mu.Lock()
193 defer capture.mu.Unlock()
194 const maxDiagnosticBytes = 4096
195 remaining := maxDiagnosticBytes - capture.buffer.Len()
196 if remaining > 0 {
197 if len(data) > remaining {
198 _, _ = capture.buffer.Write(data[:remaining])
199 capture.truncated = true
200 } else {
201 _, _ = capture.buffer.Write(data)
202 }
203 } else {
204 capture.truncated = true
205 }
206 return len(data), nil
207}

211 return capture.buffer.String()

494func setupManagerTest(t *testing.T, mode string) managerTestEnv {
495 t.Helper()
496 root := t.TempDir()
497 runtime, err := os.MkdirTemp("/tmp", "dchrt")
498 if err != nil {
499 t.Fatal(err)
500 }
501 t.Cleanup(func() { _ = os.RemoveAll(runtime) })
502 configHome := filepath.Join(root, "config-home")
503 if err := os.Mkdir(configHome, 0700); err != nil {
504 t.Fatal(err)
505 }
506 binDir := filepath.Join(root, "bin")
507 if err := os.Mkdir(binDir, 0700); err != nil {
508 t.Fatal(err)
509 }
510 binary, err := os.Executable()
511 if err != nil {
512 t.Fatal(err)
513 }
514 pidPath := filepath.Join(root, "service.pid")
515 logPath := filepath.Join(root, "systemctl.log")
516 debugPath := filepath.Join(root, "service.debug")
517 script := `#!/bin/sh
518shift
519action=$1
520echo "$action" >> "$DCH_TEST_LOG"
521case "$action" in
522 daemon-reload) exit 0 ;;
523 is-active) [ -f "$DCH_TEST_PID" ] && kill -0 "$(cat "$DCH_TEST_PID")" 2>/dev/null ; status=$?; echo "active=$status pid=$(cat "$DCH_TEST_PID" 2>/dev/null)" >> "$DCH_TEST_DEBUG"; exit "$status" ;;
524 stop) if [ -n "$DCH_TEST_FAIL_STOP_ONCE" ] && [ ! -f "$DCH_TEST_FAIL_STOP_ONCE.done" ]; then touch "$DCH_TEST_FAIL_STOP_ONCE.done"; exit 1; fi; if [ -f "$DCH_TEST_PID" ]; then kill "$(cat "$DCH_TEST_PID")" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f "$DCH_TEST_PID"; fi; exit 0 ;;
525 disable) if [ -f "$DCH_TEST_PID" ]; then kill "$(cat "$DCH_TEST_PID")" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f "$DCH_TEST_PID"; fi; exit 0 ;;
526 enable|restart|start)
527 if [ "$action" = "restart" ] && [ -n "$DCH_TEST_FAIL_RESTART_ONCE" ] && [ ! -f "$DCH_TEST_FAIL_RESTART_ONCE.done" ]; then touch "$DCH_TEST_FAIL_RESTART_ONCE.done"; exit 1; fi
528 if [ -f "$DCH_TEST_PID" ]; then kill "$(cat "$DCH_TEST_PID")" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f "$DCH_TEST_PID"; fi
529 DCH_TEST_HELPER=1 "$DCH_TEST_BINARY" -test.run '^TestCredentialServiceHelper$' >> "$DCH_TEST_DEBUG" 2>&1 &
530 echo $! > "$DCH_TEST_PID"
531 sleep 0.03
532 exit 0 ;;
533esac
534exit 1

56`~/.dch/config` is JSON without a `.json` extension. If `name` is missing, the directory name is used.60`~/.dch/config` is JSON without a `.json` extension. It stores registered project paths and enabled plugin settings. 72### GitHub App plugin
73
74The built-in GitHub App plugin is Linux-only and gives one project access to one selected GitHub repository. It requires local Docker, a systemd user service, `pass`, and a GPG agent on the host. Create and install the GitHub App, then store its RSA private key in the host's `pass` store. The key entry must be readable by the host user running the dch systemd user service.
75
76Before enabling the plugin, unlock the host GPG agent without printing the key:
77
78```sh
79pass show <entry> >/dev/null
80```
81
82The GPG agent must be able to decrypt without opening a prompt. dch invokes `pass` non-interactively; if the GPG agent's cached unlock expires, unlock the entry again before the next token refresh. The private key remains on the host and is never mounted into the container.
83
84Open **Project → Plugins** to configure and enable the plugin. Enter the App ID, installation ID, pass entry, repository (`owner/repository`), and choose `read`, `write`, or disabled for `contents` and `pull_requests`. dch verifies the service and credential before enabling. The resulting installation token is limited to that repository and selected permissions.
85
86The container needs Git 2.30 or newer, GitHub CLI (`gh`), curl, and POSIX `sh`. The plugin adds a read-only mount at `/run/dch-github`, a Git credential helper for HTTPS `github.com`, and a `gh` wrapper available from Connect shells. The wrapper requests a token for each invocation and sets `GH_TOKEN` only for that `gh` process. Other Git hosts keep their existing credential helpers; SSH URLs are unchanged. Existing lifecycle hooks are preserved. The socket directory is mode `0700` and the socket is mode `0600`; the container user must be able to connect to it, so a mismatched UID will fail.
87
88Any container process that can access the socket can request that project's short-lived token, and Docker administrators can access the mount. Use the plugin only with containers you trust.
89
90After enabling, Build the project to apply the mount and initialize the Git helper. Configuration changes and disabling the plugin also mark an existing container as needing Build. dch does not rebuild automatically. Start and Connect are blocked for an existing container until Build succeeds. Disabling stops the host service and removes its runtime files immediately; removing a project also disables its plugin before unregistering it.
91
92The systemd user service stays active when dch closes or the container stops. Tokens are kept in host memory only. The service reuses a token while it has more than five minutes left and refreshes it on the next credential request when five minutes or less remain. It does not write token files or run a refresh timer.
93
94To check that the host service is alive without requesting a credential, use:
95
96```sh
97curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 5 --unix-socket "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/dch/<project-hash>/credential.sock" http://localhost/health
98```
99
100The health endpoint returns only service status. Do not request or print `/credential` when checking service health.
101
102#### Manual Linux verification
103
1041. In **Project → Plugins**, enable the GitHub App and confirm dch verifies the service and credential without printing the token.
1052. Close dch and stop the container. Confirm the user service remains active; run the `/health` request above and expect `ok`.
1063. Build and Connect. Confirm Git fetch/push and `gh pr create` use the configured repository and expected GitHub identity and permissions.
1074. Restart the user service while the container is running, then use Git or `gh` again to confirm the mounted runtime directory exposes the replacement socket.
1085. Change the plugin settings or disable it. Confirm the existing container shows **Build required**, Start and Connect are blocked, and disabling stops the service immediately. Build to apply or remove the mount.
1096. Repeat with a container user whose UID does not match the host socket owner and confirm connection fails. Also try enabling while the GPG agent cannot decrypt non-interactively and confirm activation fails without exposing key or token contents.
110
111These checks require Linux, Docker, systemd, `pass`, and GPG agent access; they are manual integration checks.
112
113Project-specific settings belong in `.devcontainer/devcontainer.local.d/` as first-level `.json` files. dch merges them in filename order; keep local fragments out of version control when they contain machine-specific settings. dch no longer reads `.devcontainer/devcontainer.local.json`; existing files are ignored and never converted automatically.

使用行為與相容性

面向 原行為 最終行為
個人容器設定 讀取 devcontainer.local.json 只讀 local.d 第一層正常 .json 檔
合併 單一 local 檔 檔名排序；JSONC；object 深合併；array 追加去重
認證 使用者自備 Console 驗證服務與 credential 後啟用
設定變更 無 plugin 狀態 既有容器標記 Build required；阻擋 Start／Connect
停用 無 plugin 服務 停止服務並清理；容器設定需 Build 才恢復
移除 Project 取消註冊 先清理 plugin；失敗保留設定供重試
Git 使用既有 helper 僅 HTTPS github.com 走 plugin；其他 Host 保留原 helper
gh 原有命令 wrapper 每次取憑證；只對該子程序設定 GH_TOKEN
Breaking change：舊 local.json 使用者

舊檔會被靜默忽略，不提示也不自動搬移。 若要保留設定，請手動搬到 local.d 的 .json 片段。 例如：.devcontainer/devcontainer.local.d/90-user.json。 請自行將個人片段加入版本控制忽略規則。

新建容器可由 Start 套用設定。 既有容器需 Build，且保留資料移除確認。 服務在關閉 dch 或 Stop 容器後保留。 停用不會撤銷已回傳的短期 Token。

E

認證與信任邊界

快取剩餘時間超過五分鐘時直接重用。 剩餘五分鐘以下時，由下一次請求更新。 並行請求共用一次更新；沒有 timer 或 Token File。

邊界 限制
Host Linux、本機 Docker、systemd user service、pass／GPG
容器 image／Dockerfile；Git 2.30+、gh、curl、POSIX sh
Socket 目前使用者擁有的 XDG_RUNTIME_DIR；目錄 0700、Socket 0600
掛載 整個 runtime 目錄唯讀；服務重啟後可看見新 Socket
信任 可連 Socket 的程序可取得該 Project Token；Docker 管理員亦可存取
不支援 Compose、遠端 Docker、GitHub Enterprise、SSH 認證、多 repo Token

容器 UID 必須能連線 Socket；錯誤訊息提示檢查 UID。 此環境未驗證真實容器 UID 與重啟行為。
